run.name: Service Corp International
run.title: CP-OS host session (SCI)
run.summary: The company looks like a stable, cash-generative credit with moderate-to-high leverage, ample liquidity and distant maturities. Its estimated leverage is above the reported covenant figure, and shareholder returns are the main discretionary use of cash. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is SERVICE CORP INTERNATIONAL.

revenue.basis: Total revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, analyst estimate (operating income + depreciation and amortization + amortization of intangibles), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025 (C2); debt at September 30, 2026; reported covenant ratio 3.69. Analyst estimate, not the covenant measure

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Cash interest LTM from 162.9 and 159.5 million (Q3 10-Q page:18) (C4); analyst EBITDA

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 172,653 thousand (Q3 10-Q page:7); capacity as printed net of 1.3 million letters of credit (Q3 10-Q page:18). Part of cash is encumbered (page:26)

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The covenant definition, credit agreement and ratings are not supplied, so headroom and creditor protections cannot be verified.
CP-1 main limitation: No EBITDA is reported, so every EBITDA ratio is our own estimate and cannot be tied to the covenant.
